verdict.rationale: INPI's own published pages describe online filing for its core IP transactions. There is an explicit 'Dépôt de brevet en ligne' (online patent filing) page, the e-Soleau is an electronic deposit, and there are dedicated filing pages for trademarks and designs. The open-data portal probe concerns data access rather than filing, so it is not relevant here. Missing for 10: explicit statements that trademark and design filings and fee payment are completed fully online, detailed workflow documentation beyond page titles, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end online filing.
